style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy maternal baby body-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white field #FFFFFF, pale blush-pink band #FBE7E3, azure headline #2F7FC1, coral emphasis #E4574C, corn-gold prop accent #E9B63F and charcoal body text #2D2D2D; neutral temperature; one modern geometric sans-serif family with a bold azure headline, charcoal body, letter-spaced eyebrow line and one dotted-border rounded callout badge; flat-colour panels plus one bright domestic bedroom field, no scenic cut-outs; bright high-key soft daylight key from front-left with wide bounce fill, one elongated highlight across the metal lid and soft contact shadows only, around 5600K; matte paper sweep and pale blush board, soft terry bedding, matte ceramic dish, gloss reserved for the lid; thin single-weight line glyphs inside soft blush filled circles #F7D9D3, one caption each on a shared baseline; product presented as a low squat frosted glass jar with a wide polished chrome band lid, lid seam horizontal, stable scale, never re-tinted, never floating, label face kept as a blank legible field; powder only as a still mound or one contained puff at the jar mouth; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand wordmark, no medical or prevention claim copy, no age indication or percentage figure, no certification or authority marks.
noDrift: no brand wordmark, stock-site mark or placeholder logo restyled into the label

no age indication, no ingredient percentage, no net-weight figure, no registration or filing number, no laboratory, hospital or authority endorsement

style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; bold azure #2F7FC1 headline with charcoal #2D2D2D body and an optional coral #E4574C emphasis span, letter-spaced small eyebrow line, one dotted-border rounded callout badge; headline, subline and caption sizes identical across the whole set
